CAT_CLASS_FIGHTER_DESC.en: Punch your way to victory! Fighters are great at doing big strong melee attacks and smashing things to pieces!
CAT_CLASS_FIGHTER_DESC.zh:
拳打脚踢，走向胜利！
战士擅长进行强力的近战攻击，
将物体粉碎成渣！

CAT_CLASS_HUNTER_DESC.en: Shoot things from afar! Hunters are great at hitting things from a distance while staying out of danger themselves!
CAT_CLASS_HUNTER_DESC.zh:
百步穿杨！猎人擅长在远处打击目标，
同时让自己远离危险！

CAT_CLASS_MAGE_DESC.en: Blast your foes! Mages are great at casting all sorts of crazy spells and dealing elemental damage!
CAT_CLASS_MAGE_DESC.zh:
轰击你的敌人！
法师擅长施放各种疯狂的法术，
并造成元素伤害！

CAT_CLASS_MEDIC_DESC.en: Be the best friend! Clerics are great at keeping your team alive and helping them recover from taking hits!
CAT_CLASS_MEDIC_DESC.zh:
做大家最好的朋友！
牧师擅长让你的队伍存活下来，
并帮助他们从打击中恢复！

CAT_CLASS_TANK_DESC.en: Get in the way! Tanks are great at absorbing damage and pushing enemies around!
CAT_CLASS_TANK_DESC.zh:
挡在前面！坦克擅长
吸收伤害并推搡敌人！

CAT_CLASS_THIEF_DESC.en: Attack from the shadows! Thiefs are great at evading hits, collecting coins, and striking from behind!
CAT_CLASS_THIEF_DESC.zh:
暗影突袭！盗贼擅长闪避攻击、
收集金币以及从背后发起攻击！

CAT_CLASS_MONK_DESC.en: A versatile combat master! Monks can switch between ranged and melee stances and attack twice per turn!
CAT_CLASS_MONK_DESC.zh:
多面手的战斗大师！
武僧可以在远程和近战架势之间切换，
并且每回合攻击两次！

CAT_CLASS_BUTCHER_DESC.en: Meat Meat Meat Meat Meat! Butchers are great at cleaving chunks of meat off of things and have a hook to pull stuff towards them!
CAT_CLASS_BUTCHER_DESC.zh:
肉肉肉肉肉！
屠夫擅长从物体上劈下肉块，
并拥有能将物体拉向身边的钩爪！

CAT_CLASS_DRUID_DESC.en: One with nature! Druids are great at summoning animal friends and come with a special Crow counterpart!
CAT_CLASS_DRUID_DESC.zh:
天人合一！德鲁伊擅长召唤动物朋友，
并伴有一只特殊的乌鸦伙伴！

CAT_CLASS_TINKERER_DESC.en: A crafty inventor! Tinkerers are great at crafting temporary weapons and using all sorts of crazy gadgets!
CAT_CLASS_TINKERER_DESC.zh:
心灵手巧的发明家！
工匠擅长制作临时武器
并使用各种疯狂的小玩意！

CAT_CLASS_NECROMANCER_DESC.en: Rise from the dead! Necromancers are great at playing with corpses and leeching life from enemies!
CAT_CLASS_NECROMANCER_DESC.zh:
死而复生！死灵法师擅长摆弄尸体，
并从敌人身上吸取生命！

CAT_CLASS_PSYCHIC_DESC.en: Clear your mind! Psychics are great at manipulating things from afar and moving objects with their minds! Psychics also have +5 starting mana.
CAT_CLASS_PSYCHIC_DESC.zh:
清空思绪！灵能者擅长
远程操控事物并用念力移动物体！
灵能者还拥有 +5 初始法力值。

CAT_CLASS_JESTER_DESC.en: You can be anything! Jesters have no limits!
CAT_CLASS_JESTER_DESC.zh:
你可以成为任何人！
小丑没有任何限制！
